options.detail: Send by sea — Nhava Sheva → Tokyo, 10,353 km
options.tagline: Ocean routing instead of the flight
options.evidence: Air is charged at 1.58 kg CO₂e per tonne-km against 0.0084 at sea — 188× more for every tonne carried. Taking this 625 kg off the plane and onto the 10,353 km Nhava Sheva → Tokyo sailing cuts the long haul alone from 6.56 t to 54 kg. Reaching a seaport also changes the inland run — rail 0 km → 702 km, adding 4 kg. The workbook already ships to Japan by sea (1 shipment) and reaches Nhava Sheva overland on 62 shipments (FY21-22, FY22-23). The trade is time: sea takes weeks where the flight took days, so this only works where the delivery date allows it.
